title: UST-Fuse Cyber Range Digital Twin
description: A budget, virtual-first digital twin of the UST-Fuse hybrid multi-sensor UAV detection/tracking range. The software emulates radar / EO-IR / RF-SDR / acoustic sensors, time synchronisation (clock drift and calibration), network transport and fault injection; it runs two fusion pipelines — a naive Reference and the Full UST-Fuse — over identical immutable RAW data, tracks targets with a Kalman multi-target tracker (GNN / JPDA-lite association), and scores detection, tracking (RMSE, OSPA, MOTA, ID switches), calibration (ECE, Brier, reliability, selective risk) and paired statistics (effect size, 95% CI, power). It ships a rich visualisation suite, field-trial style bilingual (Ukrainian/English) reports, twelve built-in scenarios spanning ten lab works (ЛР-1…ЛР-10), a Colab notebook and full experiment provenance for reproducibility.
